caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden dressing table or vanity with a mirror attached to its top surface. The box-like base of the vanity is deep brown with red undertones, giving it a polished, wood grain appearance. The front of the base has an outward-curving drawer with two round, light-colored drawer pulls, each featuring a decorative pattern that resembles a rosette. The base rests on four short, round feet at each corner. The mirror is square, set within a thick wooden frame that matches the color and grain of the base. The mirror is held upright by two vertical, spindle-shaped supports on either side, which are detailed with turned and carved sections and anchored on small square bases at the top corners of the box. The background is plain and unadorned, and the artist’s signature appears at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Shaving Stand
